title: HvA-bestuurder Henk Geveke wil verplichte AI-cursus voor medewerkers: ‘Dit gaat te langzaam’
why: A leader of a Dutch university of applied sciences argues for a compulsory AI course for all staff, which is the sector-level version of the question your own institution is asking about AI and professional work.
caveat: Discourse, not research: a news report of one administrator's position.
